title: A builder keeps its item when the control plane restarts for an update
description: The quiet-update wait counts running builder sessions as work in flight with the 4-hour upper bound. A stub builder session running under watch survives a control-plane restart mid-item and submits the item without a new attempt.

steps.name: Restart the control plane mid-item and verify the builder submits without a new attempt and quiet-update waits for builders
